name: @whz/runtime
description: The renderer games and the studio share: a backend-neutral draw list of sprites, a WebGL2 backend with a palette lookup texture and an integer upscale, a CPU reference backend that runs in Node, and a clip player. Time is passed in; the runtime has no frame loop.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webgl.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && eslint . && vitest run && vite build --config dev/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn
